test_insert_nat: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with various null values including None, np.nan, NaT, and NA across different timezones
test_insert_invalid_na: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with a non-datetime NaT item that coerces the result to an object Index
test_insert_empty_preserves_freq: test DatetimeIndex.insert() on an empty index preserves the original frequency when the inserted item conforms
test_insert: test DatetimeIndex.insert() to insert a datetime at a specific position and verify non-datetime insertion coerces to object Index
test_insert2: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with various positions and verify freq preservation or reset to None based on inserted value
test_insert_mismatched_tzawareness: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with a naive datetime into a tz-aware index coerces the result to an object Index
test_insert_mismatched_tz: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with a mismatched timezone converts the item to the index timezone and preserves dtype
test_insert_mismatched_types_raises: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with numeric or timedelta items that are cast to an object Index instead of dt64
test_insert_castable_str: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with a castable date string that localizes to the index timezone and returns a DatetimeIndex
test_insert_non_castable_str: test DatetimeIndex.insert() with a non-parseable string that coerces the result to an object Index
